subject: Renewal playbook & expansion timeline for CobaltPay
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Bennett <sam.bennett@cobaltpay.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@cobaltpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal playbook & expansion timeline for CobaltPay

Hi Sam / Priya —

Thanks again for the great discussion yesterday. Per our renewal playbook conversation, I wanted to kick off a short thread to align on timeline, stakeholders, and the immediate asks so we can keep the renewal + expansion clean and on schedule. Summary below and next steps at the bottom.

Key goals
- Renewal term: evaluate moving from 12→24 months for predictable unit pricing
- Capacity increase: provision an additional 12 GPUs (estimated steady-state) for Q3 spikes
- Upsell: add priority SLOs and extended log retention as optional add-ons

Proposed timeline
- Week of Mar 23: internal pricing & preliminary quote (we’ll share a draft)
- Week of Mar 30: procurement review + redline window
- Week of Apr 13: sign + provisioning kickoff to meet June capacity target

Stakeholders (please confirm or add):
- CobaltPay: Sam Bennett (PM), Priya Shah (Procurement)
- Redwood: Vanessa Ortiz (AE, renewal owner), Rishi Malhotra (SE, capacity sizing), Marissa Cole (CS, QBR lead)

Immediate asks
1) Sam / Priya — can you confirm the target contract term (12 vs 24 months) and the internal approval owner for procurement?
2) Please confirm a 60–90 minute QBR slot the week of Apr 6 so Marissa can run the ops review and traffic forecast.

Attachments: renewal_playbook_v1.pdf (summary playbook), preliminary quote will follow shortly as an XLSX.

If that all looks good I’ll circulate a draft quote and two QBR timeslots.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com

From: Sam Bennett <sam.bennett@cobaltpay.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@cobaltpay.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Mar 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal playbook & expansion timeline for CobaltPay

Thanks Vanessa — this is helpful. Quick answers:
- Term: our finance team prefers 24 months if we can get a <10% uplift vs our current ARR run-rate.
- Procurement lead: Priya Shah (cc'd) handles procurement and will drive the contract review.
- QBR: tentative availability for week of Apr 6 — Tue 4/7 10:00–11:30 PT or Thu 4/9 1400–1530 PT.

Priya — I’ll hand to you for procurement cadence; Vanessa / team, can you share a draft quote and the model of cost savings at 24 months vs 12 months? Also want Rishi's sizing note on GPU count (we ran higher than expected in December).

Cheers,
Sam Bennett
Product Manager, CobaltPay
sam.bennett@cobaltpay.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Bennett <sam.bennett@cobaltpay.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 12:30:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Renewal playbook & expansion timeline for CobaltPay

Thanks for the heads-up, Sam — copying a short ops checklist so the QBR is focused:

Marissa's pre-QBR checklist:
- Run traffic delta analysis (Mar–May) — Rishi
- KV cache hit / latency trends — Ops dashboard (I’ll export)
- Incident / availability review since last renewal — include SLA windows
- Proposed playbook for capacity bursting + cost controls (auto-burst cap & per-route routing)

Rishi — I’ll need the sizing note by EOD Tue 24 Mar so we can fold it into Vanessa's prelim quote. Vanessa — I can run the QBR; I prefer Tue 4/7 10:00 PT if that slot holds.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Bennett <sam.bennett@cobaltpay.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@cobaltpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Mar 2026 11:00:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Renewal playbook & expansion timeline for CobaltPay — draft quote + QBR slots

Sam / Priya — attaching a preliminary quote and a one-page playbook: prelim_quote_CobaltPay_v1.xlsx / renewal_playbook_v1.pdf. High-level notes:
- 24-month term proposal: 8% uplift vs current, includes 12 additional GPUs (reserved pool) and priority SLOs; shows ~13% unit-cost improvement vs 12-month pricing when modeled over ARR.
- Auto-burst policy: 30% burst buffer for seasonal peaks; additional burst billed at published on-demand rates (we can cap this if you prefer).
- Data retention add-on: 90-day extended logs option in the quote.

QBR slots: Tue 4/7 10:00–11:30 PT (confirmed by Marissa) or Thu 4/9 14:00–15:30 PT. Please confirm which you prefer and Priya, if you want procurement to attend the first 30 minutes for contract questions.

Next steps (my side)
- Rishi: final sizing & cost attachments by EOD 3/24 (Rishi, are you on track?)
- Vanessa: send redline-ready contract by 3/30
- CobaltPay: confirm term + preferred QBR slot so we can lock dates

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-minute prep if helpful.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: prelim_quote_CobaltPay_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), renewal_playbook_v1.pdf (summary)
